3: This package is the public Oracle APEXlang skill for Oracle APEX generation work. Consume it like an Oracle skills domain: install or load the domain folder, then start from its root entrypoint.
4: 
5: Start with SKILL.md. It is the main root entry for routing, local context discovery, generation policy, validation behavior, and import approval rules.
6: 
7: ## Requirements
8: 
9: - Oracle APEX with APEXlang support, using the latest available 26.1 build.
10: - SQLcl for real APEXlang validation and import workflows, version 26.1.2 or newer.
11: - Java 17 or Java 21 for current SQLcl.
12: - A saved SQLcl connection or a manually supplied `db_connection_name` for Live DB validation, import, and runtime diagnostics. New-app materialization also requires the exact destination APEX workspace name.
13: - A local Oracle APEX app directory or enough authoritative context for the skill to help create one.
14: 
15: You can read the guidance and draft APEXlang artifacts without SQLcl. Any workflow that validates against Oracle APEX or imports into a workspace requires SQLcl and a resolved `db_connection_name`. The active runtime resolves workspace identity; only ambiguity or new-app materialization requires an explicit workspace choice.
16: 
17: New workspaces do not need a pre-existing `artifacts/` directory. Runtime outputs are created lazily under `APEXLANG_OUTPUT_ROOT` only when a command writes logs, reports, or export backups. Existing `apex-exports/` folders are backup/export material and are ignored for app resolution and generation unless the user explicitly asks to inspect an export backup.
18: 
19: ## Use with Oracle DB Skills
20: 
21: Generic Oracle Database, PL/SQL, SQLcl, and utPLSQL guidance is owned by Oracle upstream DB skills at `https://github.com/oracle/skills/tree/main/db`. This package does not replace or duplicate those domains. It bundles only the APEXlang-specific SQLcl runtime adapter needed for app context discovery, APEXlang validation, explicit import, and runtime diagnostics.
22: 
23: ## Package Map
24: 
25: | Path | Purpose |
26: | --- | --- |
27: | `SKILL.md` | Main root entry and routing contract |
28: | `assets/` | Routing, workspace-intelligence, metadata, and compiler catalogs |
29: | `references/` | Workflow, domain, policy, and runtime support guidance |
30: | `templates/` | APEXlang examples and templates |
31: | `tools/` | Packaged command entrypoints |
32: | `runtime/` | Runtime helpers used by packaged commands |
33: 
34: ## Prompt Examples by Task
35: 
36: Good prompts name the app, page, component, data evidence, desired behavior, and whether live validation is allowed. For Live DB work, provide `db_connection_name` only when saved-connection discovery cannot resolve one.
37: 
38: ### Whole app from beginning to end
39: 
40: ```text
41: Create a new service operations app from my table metadata for APEX workspace SERVICE_OPS_DEV. Include a home page, ticket dashboard, ticket report, ticket edit form, navigation, breadcrumbs, and default security. Check the APEXlang code before any import.
42: ```
43: 
44: ### Generate a page
45: 
46: ```text
47: Create a dashboard page for order operations with KPI cards, a monthly revenue chart, and an interactive report. Use existing schema evidence and ask before guessing missing columns.
48: ```
49: 
50: ### Page-specific change
51: 
52: ```text
53: On the customer detail page, add a right-side activity summary region, move the Save and Cancel buttons into the page header, and keep existing navigation intact.
54: ```
55: 
56: ### Generate a component
57: 
58: ```text
59: Add a shared LOV for active account managers using verified table and column names, then use it on the owner item in the customer form.
60: ```
61: 
62: ### Batch changes
63: 
64: ```text
65: Across all editable form pages, add concise help text to required items and add a validation message where users commonly submit incomplete data.
66: ```
67: 
68: ### Localization and shared components
69: 
70: ```text
71: Localize and translate my APEX application to Spanish using text messages, create or update the messages artifact, and rewire visible pages accordingly.
72: ```
73: 
74: ### Validation and debugging
75: 
76: ```text
77: Check the APEXlang code for my app using db_connection_name apex_dev. If validation reports workspace ambiguity, resolve the workspace from that session. If validation fails, explain the owning layer and suggest the smallest fix.
78: ```
79: 
80: ## Basic Workflow
81: 
82: 1. Load `SKILL.md`.
83: 2. Resolve the app path and data context; discover a saved SQLcl connection before requesting `db_connection_name` for Live DB work.
